scientific_integrity: The infinite theorem is proved analytically. The included exact checker verifies only the displayed rational counterexample and is not used to infer the general statement.
scientific_limitations: The closed-form theorem is proved for full-spark frames of excess one. No claim is made for larger excess, where the kernel has dimension at least two. A residual originality risk is equivalent oblique-projection minimax literature under substantially different terminology.
title: Unique Grassmannian duals for full-spark excess-one frames
